title: Person: Stephen
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Stephen

anchor.prefix:
—Are you good at riddles?

 Stephen answered:

 —Not very good.

 Then he said:

 —Can you answer me this one? Why is the county of Kildare like the leg of a fellow’s breeches?
anchor.suffix:
thought what could be the answer and then said:

 —I give it up.

 —Because there is a thigh in it, he said. Do you see the joke? Athy is the town in the county Kildare and a thig
